input: Book a whale watching tour for the trip north

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific northern destination determines which operators, whale species, and seasonal availability are relevant — the entire search changes based on location.
The travel dates determine which tours are actually available and whether whales are likely to be present, since sightings are highly seasonal.
The number of people and any special needs (e.g. children, elderly, mobility issues) affects which tour types and vessels are suitable.
A budget ceiling directly limits which operators and tour tiers (budget shared boat vs. private charter) can be considered.
Tour style preferences — such as small-group vs. large boat, duration, or focus (photography, education, luxury) — narrow down the right operator significantly.
Knowing whether the user wants help finding and comparing options vs. wants a specific booking made determines the immediate next action.
Understanding what a great outcome looks like — guaranteed sightings policy, reviews threshold, flexibility to cancel — sets the standard for choosing between options.

gold.taskTitle: Book a whale watching tour up north
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to research and book a whale watching tour as part of an upcoming trip to a northern destination.

questions.title: What is the specific northern destination or region?
questions.description: Identify the exact location (e.g. Iceland, Norway, Alaska, Pacific Northwest) to find relevant tour operators and whale species.

questions.title: What dates do you need the tour booked for?
questions.description: Pin down the travel dates to check tour availability and seasonal whale activity windows.

questions.title: How many people are going on the tour?
questions.description: Establish group size and whether anyone has special requirements such as young children, elderly guests, or mobility considerations.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for this tour?
questions.description: Set a spend ceiling to filter between shared group tours, premium small-group experiences, and private charters.

questions.title: Do you prefer a short trip or a full-day excursion?
questions.description: Clarify preferred tour duration and style — e.g. a 2-3 hour boat trip vs. a full-day expedition — to shortlist the right operators.

questions.title: Should I find options to compare, or book a specific one?
questions.description: Determine whether the immediate next action is researching and presenting options or proceeding directly to making a booking.

questions.title: What matters most when choosing between tour operators?
questions.description: Identify the key decision criteria — such as a whale-sighting guarantee, cancellation flexibility, review ratings, or eco-certification — to rank the options correctly.
